verdict.rationale: Evidence shows OpenHands is model-agnostic and lets users choose an LLM (openhands-gh-2, openhands-docs-26), and it offers an `ask_oracle` mechanism for consulting a stronger model without switching (openhands-docs-19), but this is a manual consult tool, not automatic per-prompt routing to the best-suited model. No evidence of an automatic routing/selection system that picks the optimal model per task.
